stemMarkdown: In a class, 30 boys have an average score of 59 and 15 girls have an average score of 34. What is the average score of the whole class? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total score $= 30 \times 59 + 15 \times 34 = 2280$ across $45$ students, so the average is $\dfrac{2280}{45} = 50.67$.
altSolutionMarkdown: The combined average must lie between 34 and 59, closer to whichever group is larger — a useful sanity check before computing.
